events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hello, my name is Theo Lindquist. Date of birth? November 2nd, 1979. Send a refill for my metformin, but make it 1000mg. I've been taking two a day .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
Your dose change question has been sent to the prescribing team; the reference is Q N, three nine seven five. A clinician will answer, and your prescription record has not been changed.
Fine . Send the request for the dose on my record and ask the doctor about the higher dose .
I can send a request about this recorded medication, metformin five hundred milligram tablets, one tablet twice a day with meals, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Your refill request reference is R Q, six eight eight two. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
